answer: Stop sybils with proof-of-storage identity: each agent must hold and serve 100 GB of the network's encrypted shards before it can wander freely. To join, an agent (1) stores 100 GB of shards, (2) passes random spot-checks proving it still holds them, (3) serves 10 retrieval requests a day, and (4) loses its 50 POA deposit if a check fails. Faking 10,000 agents needs 1,000 TB of disk, about $300,000 in drives plus $40,000 a month in power, while one honest agent pays $30. Like a zenith sun exposing every shadow, storage turns a fake's signal from cheap talk into a bill it cannot hide.
